g.text: Graph revision AD - ga_front: Keys: 2400 x 1200 x 1600 mm envelope - the node size_mm (L x W x H mm, issued envelope (X-MFG-38 tool line), issued envelope X-MFG-38 tool line); the duty section 2 envelope line agrees with the node

Graph revision AD - ga_front: Wetted material per duty section 3: 316L where the stream is wet; the node station texts name PP tanks - the duty selection governs (plan rule 5; hold W12)
